clue.text: Author not getting credit for site worth developing in Greece

indicators.note: in says the rearranged letters sit inside the abbreviation for the country

parts.note: GR is the international vehicle code for Greece

indicators.note: developing suggests something changing shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An uncredited author is building a valuable site somewhere in Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'site worth developing' as a property deal; 'developing' is the anagram signal, making HOSTWRITE, and 'in' sets it between the two letters of Greece's vehicle code.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghostwriter produces text published under someone else's name, so receives no public credit.

clue.text: A rash is developing — it's the hot paste

indicators.note: something developing is changing form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rash breaks out after eating a fiery paste.
explanation.definitionFit: Harissa is a spicy chilli condiment from North Africa, a classic example of a hot paste.

clue.text: Editor chasing almost certain voting system is shocked

indicators.note: chasing means coming behind, so the editor goes at the end
almost means the word falls just short, losing its final letter

parts.note: certain means sure
PR is proportional representation, a voting system

explanation.surface: An editor reacts with shock to a near-certain change in the electoral system.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims SURE to SUR; 'is' is taken literally, not as a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To be surprised is to be taken aback, close in sense to being shocked.

clue.text: Court officials finally protecting Germany's trees

indicators.note: protecting means wrapping around, so the outer letters go round the inner one

parts.note: to court is to woo

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word officials

parts.note: D is the international vehicle code for Germany

explanation.surface: Court officials in Germany are guarding a stand of trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Woods are areas thickly covered by trees, so the plural stands for trees.

clue.text: Charge that's a result of the setter's cheap shot

parts.note: the setter is speaking, so the setter is gives I'M

indicators.note: shot means ruined or broken up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A formal accusation follows a low blow from the crossword compiler.
explanation.definitionFit: To impeach a public official is to formally charge them with misconduct.

clue.text: Steering clear of no one, except on the way up

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
save can mean except, as in all save one

explanation.surface: Someone avoids nobody, apart from when they are climbing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the way up' turns NOISAVE round.
explanation.definitionFit: Evasion is the act of dodging something, the gerund 'steering clear of' used as a noun.

clue.text: Patient analyses?

parts.note: reads like careful, unhurried studies, but means write-ups of individual medical patients

explanation.walkthrough: 'Patient' looks like an adjective meaning unhurried; it is the noun, a person under medical care.
explanation.definitionFit: Case studies are detailed reports on particular examples, often individual patients in medicine.

clue.text: Spot daughter in the embrace of self-satisfied head of ethics

indicators.note: being embraced means being held inside the other word

parts.note: smug means self-satisfied

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of ethics

explanation.surface: A smug ethics chief embraces a daughter, picturing a spot of family drama.
explanation.definitionFit: A smudge is a small dirty mark or blot, which is a spot.

clue.text: A doctor in trouble? Quite the opposite for a lover!

indicators.note: in would put the doctor inside the trouble
this reverses the previous instruction, so the trouble goes inside the doctor instead

parts.note: mire means a difficult situation, trouble

explanation.surface: A doctor in difficulty is pictured, then the clue flips to a romantic admirer.
explanation.walkthrough: Taken straight, 'in' would bury the doctor in the mud; 'Quite the opposite' tells you to swap container and contents, so the doctor's two letters wrap the trouble instead.
explanation.definitionFit: An admirer is someone who is romantically attracted to another person, a suitor or lover.

clue.text: Annie, perhaps, is in favour of going back, writing endlessly

indicators.note: going back means the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: pro means in favour of

indicators.note: endlessly means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: hand means handwriting, a style of writing

explanation.surface: Someone named Annie supports a return, while her writing trails off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going back' turns PRO into ORP; 'endlessly' cuts HAND to HAN. Little Orphan Annie is the American comic-strip and musical heroine.
explanation.definitionFit: Annie of the comic strip and musical is the most famous parentless child, an example of the type.

clue.text: Hope we will broadcast, but in Tibet it's an article of faith

definitions.text: in Tibet it's an article of faith

indicators.note: broadcast means spoken out over the air, so the sound is what counts

parts.note: hope as a noun is a prayer, and we will contracts to we'll, together said as prayer we'll

explanation.surface: A hopeful wish is aired, contrasted with a sacred object of Tibetan devotion.
explanation.definitionFit: Tibetan Buddhists spin a cylinder holding written mantras, a devotional object used in worship.

clue.text: Offer, but lacking time to welcome American consumer

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in, so the outer word surrounds the inner one
lacking means the following letter is removed

parts.note: to tender is to offer

explanation.surface: An offer is made, but there is no time to receive an American shopper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking time' cuts TENDER to ENDER, which takes in US.
explanation.definitionFit: The end user is the final consumer of a product, the person who actually uses it.

clue.text: Right after evidence of injury — that is provoking more fear

indicators.note: after means the letter for right goes at the end

parts.note: a scar is a mark left by a wound

explanation.surface: A visible scar makes things more frightening.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarier is the comparative of scary, describing something causing greater fright.

clue.text: Character getting a share of the takings?

indicators.note: share of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone receives a cut of the day's earnings.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Character getting' as the definition; 'getting' is a link word, and the definition is 'Character' alone, a Greek letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Theta is the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, and a letter is a written character.

clue.text: Air of Athens, say, to be cleaned up

indicators.note: cleaning up means sorting and tidying, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The Athenian atmosphere is in need of cleaning up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Air' looks like the atmosphere, but it is a tune.
explanation.definitionFit: An air is a tune, and a sea shanty is a type of sailors' work song.

clue.text: Characteristic honour given to mate — not me!

indicators.note: not means the following letters are removed from the word before

parts.note: a tribute is an act of honour

explanation.surface: Someone pays a tribute to a friend while modestly declining one themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not me' removes ME from MATE to leave AT.
explanation.definitionFit: An attribute is a quality or feature belonging to someone, the same as a characteristic.

clue.text: Regard with suspicion detective's financial status

parts.note: DI is a detective inspector, and the possessive adds S
credit is a person's standing for borrowing money

explanation.surface: Someone eyes a detective's finances with suspicion.
explanation.definitionFit: To discredit something is to cause it to be doubted, refusing belief in it.

clue.text: Type of dog food

definitions.meaning: a dachshund is nicknamed a ... dog for its long body
a seasoned minced-meat link is everyday food

explanation.walkthrough: A sausage dog is a dachshund, so the first sense needs the word dog after it.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the dachshund, via its nickname, and a common meat product eaten as food.

clue.text: British in origin, independent, cold and mechanical

indicators.note: in means the letter goes inside the following word

parts.note: a root is an origin or source
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Something British-born, independent, chilly and machine-like.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in origin' looks like the first letter of British, but it is B inside ROOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Robotic describes movement or behaviour that is stiff and machine-like, so mechanical in manner.

clue.text: Actor disheartened by key sacrifices made here

parts.note: Alt is a key on a computer keyboard

indicators.note: losing its heart means the middle letters go, keeping only the outer ones

explanation.surface: An actor loses heart over a key moment in a ritual sacrifice.
explanation.definitionFit: An altar is the table in a temple or church on which offerings to a god are made.

clue.text: Bail due to be fixed in hearing

indicators.note: fixing something means rearranging it, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: At a court hearing, the bail due is to be set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hearing' looks like a court sitting; it is the sense of hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something audible is within the range of the ear, able to be heard.

clue.text: Work in which this covers the head

indicators.note: in means the work is placed inside the other word

parts.note: that can replace which in a relative clause
OP, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: A riddle about a piece of work in which something sits on the head.
explanation.definitionFit: A top hat is a tall formal hat, a piece of headwear.

clue.text: Even-tempered, just having dropped it

indicators.note: having dropped means the following letters are removed

parts.note: equitable means fair or just

explanation.surface: Someone stays calm despite having just dropped something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'just' looks like an adverb of time; it means fair.
explanation.definitionFit: An equable person is calm and not easily disturbed, which is even-tempered.

clue.text: Order up fine read?

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the letters are read bottom to top

parts.note: OBE is the Order of the British Empire
OK means fine

explanation.surface: Someone orders a good book.
explanation.definitionFit: A digital book is something to read, the noun 'read' meaning a book or text.

clue.text: Thoroughly at home with department before end of month

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: end of means the last letter of month

explanation.surface: Someone works at home with their department at the end of the month.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in a detailed, comprehensive way is the same as doing it thoroughly.

clue.text: This drumming is rubbish, as well

parts.note: tat is cheap, worthless rubbish
too means as well

explanation.surface: A critic dismisses some drumming as rubbish too.
explanation.definitionFit: A tattoo is a rhythmic drumbeat, originally a signal recalling soldiers to quarters.

clue.text: Heading off unable to feel anger or annoyance

indicators.note: heading off means removing the first letter

parts.note: numb means unable to feel
rage is fierce anger

explanation.surface: Someone who has stopped feeling either anger or irritation.
explanation.definitionFit: Umbrage is offence or resentment, as in taking umbrage, which is annoyance.

clue.text: Hearing shooter, goalie is one to put himself between opponents

definitions.text: one to put himself between opponents

indicators.note: hearing means the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: a piece is slang for a gun
a goalkeeper is a keeper

explanation.surface: At a hearing, a gunman and a goalkeeper face each other.
explanation.definitionFit: A peacekeeper intervenes to stop conflict, standing between warring sides.
